steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before resistance checks or harness service. Restore power only for live diagnostics when required.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing electrical parts.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Mandatory diagnostic mode available (§10.5). Continue with component checks below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After mandatory mode entry, proceed with OEM fault-code maintenance steps.

steps.title: Ice maker harness at main PCB
steps.body: Verify ice maker terminal at main control board is seated with no foreign matter.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify ice maker terminal at main control board is seated with no foreign matter.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace ice maker module when harness verified.

steps.title: Verify ice maker operation
steps.body: Confirm harvest and fill cycle after reseating harness. Use EYE test mode if needed (§10.10).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Confirm harvest and fill cycle after reseating harness. Use EYE test mode if needed (§10.10).

steps.title: Replace ice maker
steps.oemOutcome: Replace ice maker module when E0 persists.

steps.title: Ice maker OK
steps.oemOutcome: Ice maker function verified after harness service.
